notes.title: Patch 1.1.8 is now available!
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings, Fallen Warriors...[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37345510/9a1c94ef3f37a62143303bb80506055b5372b125.png[/img]

We’ve just released the latest [b]patch[/b] for Deathbound, focusing on resolving the minor issues, bugs, and balancing the gameplay:

[list]
[*] Fixed a few collision problems that would prevent the player's or enemies' correct navigation.
[*] Tortured Soul Spin Attack Animation adjusted to provide reaction time for a player
[*] The player will no longer die from accidentally falling during the reveries.
[*] Iulia and Agharos dodges were balanced to be more fluid and responsive.
[*] Fixed a bug where the players were unable to use numpad to rebind actions.
[*] Updated the looks of a few doors in the game to make it clearer which doors can be opened, and which can’t.
[*] Reduced Death Soldiers and Fleshdolls dodge chance and invulnerability time.
[*] Reduced Invulnerability time from Dreaded Shadows Dodges
[*] Poise/Stagger bar reset time increased by 50%.
[*] Reduced Stagger recovery time of playable characters.
[*] Fixed a bug where enemies from Mamdile Reverie would provide XP (Reverie enemies don’t provide XP)
[*] Adjusted video settings to prevent visual glitches when anti-aliasing was set to low.
[*] Fixed some missing textures issues
[*] Fixed a small bug where the music on the main menu would be interrupted by multiple inputs.
[*] Adjusted the NPC battles between the Church of Death and Essencemancers factions at the Cathedral of Life
[/list]

Thank you all for the incredible support you've shown since the launch of Deathbound. Your feedback, opinions, and suggestions have not gone unnoticed. We are committed to working on updates, fixes, and new content to ensure the best possible experience for our players. Thank you, Fallen Warriors!

If you encounter any bugs or issues during the game, please report them via [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc4ZIyPPC8O-ssOqVTGVM0w0o1BGtNcWNBoBdaDFNrEqmalSg/viewform?usp=sharing][b]THIS FORM[/b][/url], on the [b]Steam Community Hub[/b] forums, or our [b]Discord server[/b].
[url=https://bit.ly/Deathbound_Discord][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37345510/e398e0b6ec3181f4806c9e5bd04dbf157b0389a7.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.7 is here!
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings, Fallen Warriors...[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37345510/9fd881c0798023fb94662d02ec0a74494ea44142.png[/img]

We have just released the [b]next patch[/b] for Deathbound, focusing on addressing the following issues, bugs, and game balance:

[list]
[*] Fixed a few visual bugs with reveries and echoes would not properly render some ethereal object properly
[*] Fixed a visual bug where lights from the Echo of the past would remain lit after the Echo was finished.
[*] Fixed a visual error with the Agharos skin hammer during Ultra Morph Strikes. 
[*] Increased Agharos' Attack Damage and Attack Weight.
[*] Removed the center screen function from the Lock-On button to avoid accidental camera turns while locking on, which could disrupt gameplay flow.
[*] Adjusted the dodges for Therone, Anna, and Haodai to improve gameplay feel and flow.
[*] Fixed a bug where keyboard key bindings would not save. Mouse button bindings are now included as well. (Rebinding movement keys will be added in a future patch)
[*] Moved the item Essence Router (which unlocks fast travel) to a position where the player can pick it up and use fast travel much earlier in the game.
[*] Greatly reduced the Freeze Tolerance of the mysterious pursuers in the Essence Labs.
[*] Fixed a bug where the caltrops barrels in the Unbearable Beast arena would not spawn caltrops.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could get stuck between the legs and tail of the Dragon of the Deep boss.
[*] Increased Olivia's Freeze Ray Spell range and freeze power, and reduced its cast time.
[*] Increased Olivia’s Lightning Spell range and damage, and fixed a visual glitch where some walls would disappear when viewed from afar.
[*] Fixed a bug where the VFX of a boss in Higher Streets would wrongfully spawn.
[*] Made adjustments to Haodai and Olivia’s enchantment spells to prevent players from accidentally triggering a morph strike after casting them.
[*] Improved visual cues for doors that cannot be opened in the Life’s Cathedral.
[*] Improved the interaction regions for doors to make it easier to approach and open them quickly.
[*] Fixed a bug where small explosive spiders would spawn from broken eggs.
[*] Fixed a collision issue where the player could walk off the balcony of the Life’s Cathedral.
[*] Removed the stamina cost for sprinting while out of combat.
[*] Fixed a visual bug where Agharos would not properly hold his hammer. 
[*] Increased the stamina of all Playable Essences.
[*] Fixed a bug where some items would not spawn in the Life’s Cathedral courtyard.
[*] Improved the interaction regions for ladders, echoes, and other objects to make it easier to approach and interact with them.
[/list]
We would like to take a moment to thank you all for the amazing support you’ve shown since the launch of Deathbound. Your feedback, opinions, and suggestions do not go unnoticed. Rest assured, we read every comment, review, and message you send us. We will continue to work on fixes and new content to offer you the best possible experience with our soulslike. Thank you, Fallen Warriors!

If you encounter any bugs or issues during the game, please report them via [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc4ZIyPPC8O-ssOqVTGVM0w0o1BGtNcWNBoBdaDFNrEqmalSg/viewform?usp=sharing][b]THIS FORM[/b][/url], on the [b]Steam Community Hub[/b] forums, or our [b]Discord server[/b].

notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings, Fallen Warriors...[/h3]

We just released the [b]second patch[/b] for [b]Deathbound[/b]. We focused on the following issues, bugs, and balancing the game:

[list]
[*] Normal Morph Strikes now have a generous invincibility window at the beginning, like Ultra Morph Strikes to make them more reliable
[*] Nerfed Mobs from Essence Labs, Akratya’s Depths, and Life's Cathedral
[*] Slightly increased XP drop in all areas starting from Zehrimbal, Except Life's Cathedral
[*] Fixed bug where the camera sometimes unlocks the target
[*] Fixed a bug where players could get stuck inside The Holder enemy.
[*] Fixed attack hitbox issues where the player attack would go through the enemy without hitting him.
[*] Further Balance in the EIthalos fight
[*] Further Reduced HP and Damage of some enemies in Eithalos Fight
[*] Reduced Eithalos Lightning Spell Attack Weight.
[*] Balanced The Holder Roll Attack Animations to increase the tell
[*] Overall balancing of some enemies
[*] Balanced Final Boss Stats
[*] Adjusted Dragon of the Deep animations so arms and tentacles Pustules stay in melee range longer.
[*] Dragon of the Deep Total HP Reduced.

notes.title: 1 Day Left & Global Release Time
notes.notes:
Greetings, Fallen Warriors...

Brace yourself for a bloody crusade. [b]Deathbound[/b] launches worldwide [b]tomorrow[/b] on [b]PC[/b], [b]Xbox Series X|S[/b] and [b]PlayStation 5[/b]! Read today's community hub post and craft unbreakable synergy within the brutal world of Zieminal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37345510/e101edaa7118bd4c700725142498f394f00f33b7.png[/img]

Deathbound is all about the party system, massive combo attacks, and a great story, all set in a unique techno-fantasy environment that blends sci-fi and medieval elements to create a dark and immersive atmosphere.

Join us as we explore [b]Deathbound's key features[/b] that will convince you to take up the fight in the Forbidden City.

[h3]The Essence[/h3]
Acquire the skills, memories, and identities of fallen warriors from across Akratya. Merge their unique personalities and combat styles, switching between them effortlessly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37345510/646db9253ea88d686fa248e5a4260265c7a4200e.gif[/img]

[h3]Party System[/h3]
The essences you absorb shape your party. Deathbound boasts a comprehensive party system, enabling you to develop a playstyle through talent trees. Seamlessly switch between fallen warriors to utilize their skills and abilities. The alliances they held in life will influence their synergy in death.

[h3]Dynamic Morphing[/h3]
Unleash the combined might of fallen warriors with devastating Morphstrikes. Employ various attack styles to execute powerful combos and finishing moves, crushing all who stand in your way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37345510/02c23b97019facb77b07aa9e45c2db87303c3d6d.gif[/img]

[h3]Brutal World[/h3]
Zieminal is a world where a technological past intertwines with a medieval present, housing diverse cultures. The Forbidden City of Akratya awaits your exploration. Navigate a city crumbling under the weight of a grand crusade. With its stark brutalist architecture and fusion of technology, Akratya teeters on the brink of oblivion.

[h3]Unforgiving Monsters and Bosses[/h3]
Confront ruthless enemies designed to test your limits. Each boss in Deathbound embodies one of the five stages of grief, demanding the full attention of any soul brave enough to face them.

[h3]Global Release Time[/h3]
The time when the Fallen Warriors will cross the gates of the Forbidden City is now confirmed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37345510/70f8fb89338a285e6d3d40bb2fdcfaf7c41f9d57.png[/img]

You should be ready now to enter the gates of the Forbidden City of Akratya and face the abominations lurking in its streets. Join the bloody crusade tomorrow on PC, Xbox Series X|S or PlayStation 5!

Thank you for your continued support. We can't wait for you to experience the world of Deathbound.

Gather essence by [b]wishlisting Deathbound on Steam[/b] and joining the [b]official Deathbound Discord server[/b] today.
